summary.en: A wipe line brings real lines of a real file over the frames they made; an underline pairs a token with the frame below it, one a beat.
summary.zh: 一道擦除线带来一份真实文件的真实几行，压在它们做出的画格上；下划线把一个词和下方的画格配对，一拍一个。

fits: Showing that a line of input made a piece of output.
notFor: Code written for the film; outputs not made by those lines.

intent.en: Register a line of input with the frame it produced.
intent.zh: 让一行输入和它产生的画格对齐。

content.en: 2–6 quoted lines with the file and first line number, 1–4 pairs { line, token, result }, a claim (≤ 5 words).
content.zh: 2–6 行引用代码（带文件与首行行号）、1–4 组 { 行, 词, 结果 }、一句主张（≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 表明一行输入做出了一段输出。

notFor.zh: 为片子现写的代码；不是由这些行做出的输出。

pairs.note: the band rises from its seam

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
